units.detect_m: sight radius, x0.6 in blizzard, x0.7 at night unless player has light on
units.accuracy: 0..1 hit chance per shot at 15 m, linear to half at range_m
units.resistances: fraction of damage removed (negative = weakness, e.g. fire -0.5 = +50%)

families.raider: Hostile civilians & militias (looter, bridge_boy = Viaduct Crew, watch_militia, desperate_family, authority_guard = Recovery Authority, compact_militia = Lahontan Compact, harbor_militia = the Floor). Human, talkable, flee. Ch1+.
families.soldier: Federal Army: Task Force Ironwood (ironwood_patrol, ironwood_checkpoint) Ch5+, Remnant (remnant_patrol) and the stranded recovery_detail Ch7+. Human, armored, sparable.
families.dog: Animals: feral_dog and coyote, Ch7+. Flee fire/flares.
families.husk: Radiation-sick, hypothermic, starving PEOPLE, Ch8+. Not infected and not monsters. Talk-down possible.
families.stalker: Tallmen (faction annex): escaped LONG SLEEP subjects from the Dixie Valley Annex. Ch7+. Heat-seeking, light-averse, hit-and-retreat, max 3 active. Count unknown (tallmen_killed / den_killed only).
families.assimilated: Hollows (story assimilation{}), Ch8-10: people and animals a Tallman fed on and kept. They mimic, stalk and ambush. Not contagious: the player and companions can never become assimilated. Light/fire break their disguise.
families.set_piece: Invulnerable or non-interactable scripted threats (ironwood_drone, ironwood_mrap, ironwood_bradley, tallman_glimpse).

code_kind_note: code_kind maps to js/enemies.js KINDS meshes/AI. Existing: 'raider', 'dog', 'husk'. New kinds: 'stalker' (tallman; fallback 'dog' AI on a tall mesh), 'mimic' (assimilated_human; engine_fallback_code_kind 'husk'), 'mimic_beast' (assimilated_animal; engine_fallback_code_kind 'dog'). If a kind isn't implemented, use engine_fallback_code_kind and still apply the 'behavior' block flags you can.

enemies.name: Viaduct Crew
enemies.desc: Laid-off warehouse kids and 4th Street motel residents from under the I-80 viaduct. Pipes, pistols, molotovs. Break and run at 50% losses.

behavior.hostile_if: run with drugs / draw weapon / steal

behavior.note: Lund family Ch4. Killing them is a story event.

enemies.name: Floor militia
enemies.desc: Silver Spur casino workers with rifles and shotguns. Hostile only if bridge_choice=open.

enemies.name: Ironwood recovery detail
enemies.desc: Stranded, starving Ironwood squad (6) at the Dixie Valley Annex hangar under SFC Brandt. Variant of remnant_patrol at 60% HP; low ammo. Hostile by default; talked down by Ruiz, ironwood_id or food (canned_food). Outcome -> recovery_detail_outcome.

enemies.name: Feral dog
enemies.note: Drops nothing. Starving pets; no butchering by design (tone).

enemies.name: Coyote
enemies.desc: High-desert coyote (Revision 2 replacement for the v1 pack animal; same 'dog' AI). Smaller and faster than feral dogs; packs of 3-5 on the Lahontan flats, Dixie Valley and Steamboat Creek. Flee flares. No butchering by design.

enemies.name: Husk (sick/freezing person)
enemies.desc: Radiation-sick, hypothermic, starving PEOPLE. Not infected, not monsters, not supernatural. Erratic; rush heat/food. Talk-down: iodide_tablets + wool_blanket + kindness>=4. Tallmen follow husks. Re-dress old mockup models as under-dressed humans.

enemies.name: Tallman

heat_seek.note: Sealed shelters (shelter_sealed, SEAL%) hide heat: detect x(1-seal/100).

light_aversion.on_repel: retreat 25 m for 6 s, then circle
light_aversion.note: Sustained light pushes it back; it never charges through a lit floodlight (lamp line).

behavior.wraith: Wraith WARNs first (points at Tallmen), refuses HOLD.
behavior.count_rule: Total number at large is UNKNOWN. Track only tallmen_killed (int, default 0) and den_killed (bool). Never store or show a remaining count.

den_torpid.note: Torpid in the den; non-hostile unless shot. Killing both sets den_killed (dialogue ch07_hotsprings_den).

visual: flat reflective eyes catch the flashlight
moves on all fours at distance, upright to strike

enemies.desc: Escaped LONG SLEEP subject from the Dixie Valley Annex. Seeks heat; retreats from sustained light; hit-and-retreat; max 3 active anywhere; disengages after losing 2 or at dawn. Never a horde. Engine: on each kill add tallmen_killed +1.

enemies.desc: A person a Tallman fed on and kept (in-world: a Hollow). Wears the victim's clothes and voice. Calls for help in a voice that is almost right, waits motionless at doorways and fog edges, then lunges. Bright light breaks the disguise and forces an ambush or a retreat. Not contagious; cannot be talked down.

enc_ch01_watch_standoff.note: Wraith steps in front; ends if you holster or run.

enc_ch03_fire_rescue.note: house_fire heat hazard; carry Gil out.

enc_ch04_ramp_chase.note: Tug chase off the ramp; no kills required.

enc_ch05_compact_attack.note: Escort path. Sets fired_on_blockade via dialogue.

enc_ch07_road_tallman.note: FIRST Tallman fight. Light pushes it back; it retreats wounded.

enc_ch07_tolliver.note: Single armed guard (use authority_guard stats). Only if you fire.

enc_ch07_holds_tallman.note: Wing A corridor; flees to the flooded stair.

enc_ch08_husk.note: A sick man. Not a monster.

enc_ch08_hollow_first.note: FIRST Hollow: Dale Henley in his kitchen (ch08_henley_house). Interior, flashlight only. Sets up the paranoia.

enc_ch08_door_mimic.note: Only if the player opens the door to the midnight knock (ch08_door). Close quarters in the hallway; SEAL drops while open.

enc_ch09_hollow_ambush.note: Whiteout voice ambush (ch09_voices): a Hollow calls in Walt's voice off the rope line. Following it costs one column member.

enc_ch09_animal_pack.note: Assimilated coyote pack on river_ice (ch09_voices). Silent; flee flares; break off after losing 2.

enc_ch09_ice_tallmen.note: Max 3; they test, then break off after losing 1.

enc_ch10_siege_n1.note: Repair a cut lamp cable while watched. Usually no attack.

enc_ch10_siege_n2.note: Clamp the cooling-water line under the lights.

enc_ch10_hollow_prowlers.note: Siege night 2 (ch10_siege_night2): Hollows call names from past the lamp line; animal prowlers test each pole's dark edge. Night 3 reuses their voice barks between lamps.

enc_ch10_siege_n3.note: Push on one side (if den_killed and tallmen_killed>=3) or two. Disengage after losing 2 or at dawn.

enc_ch10_gate_battle.note: Only if the Remnant doesn't stand down.
